# 2.1 Q2)

## selecting the 10 bonds

```{r}
# Load the master dataset:
bonds <- read_csv("bonds_master_all.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# The Chosen 10 Bonds:
chosen_isins <- c(
  "CA135087R978", # CAN 4 Aug 26
  "CA135087S547", # CAN 3 Feb 27
  "CA135087T461", # CAN 2.5 Aug 27
  "CA135087T958", # CAN 2.25 Feb 28
  "CA135087Q491", # CAN 3.25 Sep 28
  "CA135087Q988", # CAN 4 Mar 29
  "CA135087R895", # CAN 3.5 Sep 29
  "CA135087S471", # CAN 2.75 Mar 30
  "CA135087T388", # CAN 2.75 Sep 30
  "CA135087T792"  # CAN 2.75 Mar 31
)

# Build the assignmnt label from Coupon + Maturity Date
make_can_label <- function(coupon_str, maturity_str) {
  coupon_num <- as.numeric(str_remove(coupon_str, "%"))         
  mat <- mdy(maturity_str)                                      
  paste0("CAN ", coupon_num, " ", format(mat, "%b %y"))          
}
```

## Build the Chosen bonds'dataset:
```{r}
# The dataset
bonds_10 <- bonds %>%
  filter(ISIN %in% chosen_isins) %>%
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    maturity_date = mdy(`Maturity Date`),
    issue_date = mdy(`Issue Date`),
    can_label = make_can_label(Coupon, `Maturity Date`)
  ) %>%
  arrange(maturity_date, date)

# A quick Check
bonds_10 %>%
  distinct(ISIN, can_label, Coupon, `Issue Date`, `Maturity Date`, `Issue Volume`) %>%
  arrange(mdy(`Maturity Date`)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

# 2.2 Q4a)
```{r}
# 1) Helpers: build coupon schedule & compute YTM by solving PV(y)=Price

# Generate coupon payment dates (semi-annual) from maturity backwards
coupon_schedule <- function(settle, maturity, freq = 2) {
  step_months <- 12 / freq

  # generate coupon dates backwards from maturity
  d <- seq(from = maturity,
           to   = settle - days(1),   # ensure we include the first coupon after settle
           by   = paste0("-", step_months, " months"))

  d <- sort(as.Date(d))
  d[d > settle]   # keep only future payment dates
}


# Present value given yield y (APR with compounding freq), using ACT/365 for times
bond_pv <- function(y, price_per_100, coupon_rate, settle, maturity, freq = 2, face = 100) {
  pay_dates <- coupon_schedule(settle, maturity, freq = freq)
  pay_dates <- pay_dates[pay_dates > settle]  # cashflows strictly after settlement

  if (length(pay_dates) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  # year fractions (ACT/365) from settle to each payment date
  t <- as.numeric(pay_dates - settle) / 365.0

  cpn <- (coupon_rate/100) * face / freq
  cashflows <- rep(cpn, length(pay_dates))
  cashflows[length(cashflows)] <- cashflows[length(cashflows)] + face

  disc <- (1 + y/freq) ^ (-freq * t)
  sum(cashflows * disc)
}

# Solve for YTM with uniroot
ytm_from_price <- function(price_pct, coupon_rate, settle, maturity, freq = 2) {
  price <- price_pct # price in "per 100 par" units since it's % of par
  # if already matured or bad price
  if (is.na(price) || price <= 0 || maturity <= settle) return(NA_real_)

  f <- function(y) bond_pv(y, price, coupon_rate, settle, maturity, freq = freq) - price

  # Bracket yields (allow slightly negative; expand if needed)
  lower <- -0.05
  upper <-  0.30

  # If function doesn't change sign, try expanding once
  fl <- f(lower); fu <- f(upper)
  if (is.na(fl) || is.na(fu)) return(NA_real_)
  if (fl * fu > 0) {
    lower2 <- -0.20
    upper2 <-  0.80
    fl2 <- f(lower2); fu2 <- f(upper2)
    if (is.na(fl2) || is.na(fu2) || fl2 * fu2 > 0) return(NA_real_)
    lower <- lower2; upper <- upper2
  }

  uniroot(f, lower = lower, upper = upper, tol = 1e-10)$root
}

```

```{r}
# 2) Compute YTM for each (date, bond)

ytm_daily <- bonds_10 %>%
  mutate(
    date = ymd(date),
    maturity_date = mdy(`Maturity Date`),
    coupon_rate = as.numeric(str_remove(Coupon, "%")),
    price_pct = `Close Price (% of par)`,
    ttm_years = as.numeric(maturity_date - date) / 365.0,
    can_label = make_can_label(Coupon, `Maturity Date`)
  ) %>%
  group_by(date, ISIN) %>%
  summarise(
    can_label = first(can_label),
    coupon_rate = first(coupon_rate),
    maturity_date = first(maturity_date),
    ttm_years = first(ttm_years),
    price_pct = first(price_pct),
    ytm = ytm_from_price(first(price_pct), first(coupon_rate), first(date), first(maturity_date), freq = 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ytm), ttm_years > 0, ttm_years <= 6)  # keep a bit beyond 5y for stable interpolation

# Quick check: see computed yields
ytm_daily %>% arrange(date, ttm_years) %>% print(n = 30)
```

```{r}

# 3) Build 5-year yield curve for each day via Piecewise Linear Interpolation

grid_years <- seq(0.25, 5.00, by = 0.25)

curve_daily <- ytm_daily %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x %>% arrange(ttm_years)
    # Need at least 2 points to interpolate
    if (nrow(d) < 2) return(tibble())

    f <- approxfun(d$ttm_years, d$ytm, method = "linear", rule = 2)

    tibble(
      ttm_years = grid_years,
      ytm = f(grid_years)
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

```

## Graph Altogether

```{r}
# 4) Plot: 5-year yield curve for each day, superimposed
ggplot(curve_daily, aes(
  x = ttm_years,
  y = ytm,
  colour = as.factor(date),
  group = date
)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "5-Year Yield Curve (YTM) — Daily Curves Superimposed",
    x = "Time to Maturity (years)",
    y = "Yield to Maturity (annual, compounded semi-annually)",
    colour = "Date"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

# 2.2 Q4 b)

```{r}
# Step 1 - helpers
 yearfrac_act365 <- function(start_date, end_date) {
  as.numeric(end_date - start_date) / 365.0
}

bond_cashflows <- function(settle, maturity, coupon_rate, freq = 2, face = 100) {
  pay_dates <- coupon_schedule(settle, maturity, freq = freq)
  pay_dates <- pay_dates[pay_dates > settle]  # only future CFs

  cpn <- (coupon_rate/100) * face / freq
  cf  <- rep(cpn, length(pay_dates))
  cf[length(cf)] <- cf[length(cf)] + face

  tibble(
    pay_date = pay_dates,
    t = yearfrac_act365(settle, pay_dates),
    cf = cf
  )
}

```

```{r}
# Step 2 - prepare per date cashflow + prices

bond_panels <- bonds_10 %>%
  mutate(
    coupon_rate   = as.numeric(str_remove(Coupon, "%")),
    maturity_date = mdy(`Maturity Date`),
    price         = `Close Price (% of par)`  # per 100 par
  ) %>%
  select(date, ISIN, coupon_rate, maturity_date, price)

# Keep ALL bonds up to 5Y
bond_panels_1to5 <- bond_panels %>%
  mutate(ttm = as.numeric(maturity_date - date) / 365) %>%
  filter(ttm > 0, ttm <= 5)
```

```{r}
# Step 3 — bootstrap function for 1 day
bootstrap_spot_one_day <- function(day_df, freq = 2, face = 100) {

  settle <- unique(day_df$date)
  stopifnot(length(settle) == 1)

  # Build CF tables, sort by maturity
  cf_list <- day_df %>%
    mutate(cf_tbl = purrr::pmap(
      list(maturity_date, coupon_rate),
      ~ bond_cashflows(settle, ..1, ..2, freq = freq, face = face)
    )) %>%
    select(ISIN, price, maturity_date, cf_tbl) %>%
    arrange(maturity_date)

  known_t <- numeric(0)
  known_D <- numeric(0)

  # log-linear interpolation of D(t) for t within known range,
  # and a "power" extrapolation for t < min(known_t) using the first known D
  D_interp <- function(t) {
    if (length(known_t) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(t)))

    # only one point known: assume flat continuously in log(D) between 0 and T1
    if (length(known_t) == 1) {
      return(known_D[1]^(t / known_t[1]))
    }

    t <- as.numeric(t)

    # within range: log-linear
    f_in <- approxfun(known_t, log(known_D), method = "linear", rule = 1)
    D_out <- exp(f_in(pmin(pmax(t, min(known_t)), max(known_t))))

    # below min known: power extrapolation from first point
    idx_lo <- which(t < min(known_t))
    if (length(idx_lo) > 0) {
      D_out[idx_lo] <- known_D[1]^(t[idx_lo] / known_t[1])
    }

    # above max known: allow linear extrap on log(D)
    idx_hi <- which(t > max(known_t))
    if (length(idx_hi) > 0) {
      f_hi <- approxfun(known_t, log(known_D), method = "linear", rule = 2)
      D_out[idx_hi] <- exp(f_hi(t[idx_hi]))
    }

    D_out
  }

  for (k in seq_len(nrow(cf_list))) {

    price_k <- cf_list$price[[k]]
    cfs_k   <- cf_list$cf_tbl[[k]]

    T <- max(cfs_k$t)  # maturity time (in years)

    cf_T <- cfs_k %>%
      filter(t == T) %>%
      summarise(cf = sum(cf)) %>%
      pull(cf)

    earlier <- cfs_k %>% filter(t < T)

    pv_earlier <- 0
    if (nrow(earlier) > 0) {
      D_earlier <- D_interp(earlier$t)
      if (all(is.na(D_earlier))) {
        pv_earlier <- NA_real_
      } else {
        pv_earlier <- sum(earlier$cf * D_earlier)
      }
    }

    # If pv_earlier is NA (edge case), treat as zero-coupon approx for first step
    if (is.na(pv_earlier)) pv_earlier <- 0

    # Solve for the maturity discount factor
    D_T <- (price_k - pv_earlier) / cf_T

    known_t <- c(known_t, T)
    known_D <- c(known_D, D_T)
  }

  out <- tibble(t = known_t, D = known_D) %>%
    arrange(t) %>%
    mutate(
      spot = 2 * (D^(-1/(2*t)) - 1)   # semi-annual compounded spot rate
    )

  out
}
```

```{r}
# Step 4 — run bootstrap for ALL days, then interpolate spot onto 1–5y grid
grid_1_5 <- seq(1.00, 5.00, by = 0.25)

spot_daily_raw <- bond_panels_1to5 %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  group_modify(~ bootstrap_spot_one_day(.x, freq = 2, face = 100), .keep = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

spot_daily_curve <- spot_daily_raw %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    d <- .x %>% arrange(t)
    f <- approxfun(d$t, d$spot, method = "linear", rule = 2)
    tibble(t = grid_1_5, spot = f(grid_1_5))
  }) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
# Step 5 — plot
ggplot(spot_daily_curve,
       aes(x = t, y = spot, colour = as.factor(date), group = date)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title  = "1–5 Year Spot (Zero) Curves — Daily Curves Superimposed",
    x      = "Maturity (years)",
    y      = "Spot rate (annual, semi-annual compounding)",
    colour = "Date"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# 2.2 Q4 c)
```{r}
# Step 1 — extract the spot rates
spot_int <- spot_daily_curve %>%
  filter(t %in% 1:5) %>%
  select(date, t, spot)

```

```{r}
# Step 2 — compute 1-year forwards starting at 1 year
fwd_T <- 2:5  # keep your same choice

forward_daily_curve <- spot_int %>%
  filter(t == 1) %>%
  rename(S1 = spot) %>%
  select(date, S1) %>%
  inner_join(
    spot_int %>% filter(t %in% fwd_T) %>% rename(T = t, ST = spot),
    by = "date"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n = T - 1,
    # discount factors from semiannual-compounded spot rates
    D1 = (1 + S1/2)^(-2 * 1),
    DT = (1 + ST/2)^(-2 * T),
    # 1-year forward rate from year 1 to year T (APR, semiannual comp)
    fwd_1yr = 2 * ((D1/DT)^(1/(2*n)) - 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(date, T)
```

```{r}
# Step 3 — plot

ggplot(forward_daily_curve,
       aes(x = T, y = fwd_1yr, colour = as.factor(date), group = date)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "1-Year Forward Rates Starting in 1 Year (from Bootstrapped Spot Curve)",
    x = "Forward end date T (years)",
    y = "Forward rate f(1,T) (APR, semi-annual compounding)",
    colour = "Date"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Step 1 — Build the 1y–5y yield table 
yields_1to5 <- curve_daily %>%
  filter(ttm_years %in% 1:5) %>%
  mutate(mat = paste0("y", as.integer(ttm_years))) %>%
  select(date, mat, ytm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mat, values_from = ytm) %>%
  arrange(date)

yields_1to5
```
```{r}
# Step 2 — Compute daily log-returns for those 5 yields
yield_ret <- yields_1to5 %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("y"), ~ log(.x / dplyr::lag(.x)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(y1))   # drop first row (no lag)

yield_ret

# Covariance matrix for yield log-returns
yield_cov <- cov(yield_ret %>% select(y1, y2, y3, y4, y5))
yield_cov

```

```{r}
# Step 4 — Build the forward rate table (levels)
fwd_1to4 <- forward_daily_curve %>%
  filter(T %in% 2:5) %>%
  mutate(fwd = paste0("f", T-1)) %>%   # f1,f2,f3,f4 correspond to 1-1,...,1-4
  select(date, fwd, fwd_1yr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fwd, values_from = fwd_1yr) %>%
  arrange(date)

fwd_1to4

```

```{r}
# Step 5 — Compute daily log-returns for the 4 forward rates
fwd_ret <- fwd_1to4 %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("f"), ~ log(.x / dplyr::lag(.x)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(f1))

fwd_ret

```

```{r}
# Covariance matrix for forward-rate log-returns
fwd_cov <- cov(fwd_ret %>% select(f1, f2, f3, f4))
colnames(yield_cov) <- rownames(yield_cov) <- c("1Y","2Y","3Y","4Y","5Y")
colnames(fwd_cov)   <- rownames(fwd_cov)   <- c("1y-1y","1y-2y","1y-3y","1y-4y")

yield_cov
fwd_cov
```

# 2.2 Q6

```{r}
# Step 1: eigen-decomposition
eig_yield <- eigen(yield_cov)
eig_fwd   <- eigen(fwd_cov)

```

```{r}
# Step 2: eigenvalue tables + variance explained
yield_eigs <- tibble(
  component = paste0("PC", seq_along(eig_yield$values)),
  eigenvalue = eig_yield$values,
  var_explained = eig_yield$values / sum(eig_yield$values)
)

fwd_eigs <- tibble(
  component = paste0("PC", seq_along(eig_fwd$values)),
  eigenvalue = eig_fwd$values,
  var_explained = eig_fwd$values / sum(eig_fwd$values)
)

yield_eigs
fwd_eigs

```

```{r}
# Step 3: eigenvector (loading) matrices with labels
yield_loadings <- as.data.frame(eig_yield$vectors)
colnames(yield_loadings) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(ncol(yield_loadings)))
yield_loadings$maturity <- rownames(yield_cov)
yield_loadings <- yield_loadings %>% relocate(maturity)

fwd_loadings <- as.data.frame(eig_fwd$vectors)
colnames(fwd_loadings) <- paste0("PC", seq_len(ncol(fwd_loadings)))
fwd_loadings$tenor <- rownames(fwd_cov)
fwd_loadings <- fwd_loadings %>% relocate(tenor)

yield_loadings
fwd_loadings
```

```{r}
# Step 4: first eigenpair (largest eigenvalue = PC1)
lambda1_yield <- eig_yield$values[1]
v1_yield <- eig_yield$vectors[, 1]
names(v1_yield) <- rownames(yield_cov)

lambda1_fwd <- eig_fwd$values[1]
v1_fwd <- eig_fwd$vectors[, 1]
names(v1_fwd) <- rownames(fwd_cov)

lambda1_yield
v1_yield

lambda1_fwd
v1_fwd

# normalization
v1_yield_norm <- v1_yield / sum(abs(v1_yield))
v1_fwd_norm   <- v1_fwd   / sum(abs(v1_fwd))

v1_yield_norm
v1_fwd_norm

```
